card.title: PS5 Standby Current Draw Diagnostics and Fault Isolation

claims.statement: A working board draws around 321mA in standby before returning to 4mA to 10mA.
claims.quote: WORKING / GOOD +- 0 mA +- 0 mA Check BIOS and fuses, +12V power supply, Check for short on the +12V input

claims.statement: Stuck current at 7mA indicates checking Dialog IC voltages, 25MHz and 32KHz clocks, and BIOS communication.
claims.quote: When console get’s standby power if it is stuck at 7mA. Check the voltages of Dialog ic and frequency of the 25Mhz clock and the 32Khz clock of the Southbridge IC.

claims.statement: Current draw going to 175mA and dropping back to 10mA points to a bad SSD controller.
claims.evidence: Standby current anomaly linked to SSD circuit.
claims.quote: When you see a current draw in standby of 175 mA and then back to 10Ma. There can be a bad SSD controller IC.

procedure: Check for short on the +12V input if current draw is 0mA.
Verify Dialog IC voltages and clock frequencies if stuck at 7mA standby current.
Inspect SSD controller and measure current draw through fuse pads if current behavior shows 175mA dropping to 10mA.
card.caveats: Current draws are diagnostic guides and require verification with scope and thermal imaging.
